body:
`@react-email/render` imports `prettier/plugins/html` and `prettier/standalone`, but **prettier is in neither `package.json` nor `node_modules`**.

Impact, both verified this session:
- Two test suites fail to load on a clean tree: `src/__tests__/billing-generation-history.test.ts`, `src/__tests__/billing-resident-filter.test.ts`. Confirmed by stashing all local changes and re-running.
- The **dev server breaks** once any route pulling in `@react-email/render` recompiles. Login stops working, and the Next.js error overlay intercepts all clicks.

Currently masked by `npm install --no-save prettier`, which deliberately leaves `package.json` and the lockfile untouched — so **a fresh `npm ci` reproduces the breakage**.

Fix: add `prettier` as a devDependency at a version satisfying `@react-email/render`, and confirm `npm ci && npm test` is green from scratch.

labels.name: ready-for-agent
labels.description: Fully specified, ready for an AFK agent

title: prettier is undeclared and uninstalled, breaking tests and the dev server
